name: Deep Underground Neutrino Experiment (DUNE) Near Detector Conceptual Design Report

summary.plain: The design plan for DUNE's near detector complex at Fermilab, which measures the neutrino beam before it oscillates.
summary.technical: DUNE ND CDR (arXiv:2103.13910, Mar 2021): conceptual design of the composite near detector (ND-LAr, TMS/ND-GAr, SAND) used to characterise the LBNF beam and constrain oscillation systematics.
